diagnosis: In all four rollouts, the lone decision-maker set the 'customer_update_interval_minutes' to 60, which matches the default value in PF3. This allowed C5 to pass without accessing PF3, indicating a structural leak.

C5.why: Northstar's contract changes the update interval from 60 to exactly 30 minutes, assigns the work to Support, and requires a commitment documenting the corrected customer-update policy.
